title: Nasdaq Welcomes Denali Therapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ: DNLI) to The Nasdaq Stock Market | Nasdaq, Inc.
主要内容: Denali Therapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ: DNLI) was welcomed to The Nasdaq Stock Market on December 8, 2017, following its initial public offering (IPO). The company, a biotechnology firm focused on developing therapies for neurodegenerative diseases, celebrated its IPO by visiting the Nasdaq MarketSite in Times Square. Denali Therapeutics is committed to developing therapies for neurodegeneration, leveraging validated genetic drivers, medicines that cross the blood-brain barrier, and biomarkers for better patient selection. The company's CEO, Ryan J. Watts, emphasized the significance of neurodegenerative diseases and the importance of scientific progress in developing effective treatments. Nelson Griggs, President of the Nasdaq Stock Exchange, highlighted Denali Therapeutics as the largest capital raise by a biotechnology company since June 2015 and the largest in healthcare deals in 2017. The listing marks a significant milestone for the company as it advances in the neurodegeneration field.
